name: Sharm el-Sheikh
title: Holidays in Sharm el-Sheikh
intro: Red Sea resorts between the desert mountains and some of the world's best coral reefs, with winter sun and snorkelling straight from the beach. Here's what Sharm el-Sheikh is like, when to go and how long to stay.
image_alt: Beach umbrellas on a sandy bay at Sharm el-Sheikh, with reefs and boats in the turquoise Red Sea

facts.label: Entry
facts.value: Free Sinai visa or visa on arrival

facts_note: A free Sinai-only stamp covers stays in the resort area; buy a full visa on arrival to travel further. Check the latest travel advice on GOV.UK before you book.
when_to_go: March to May and October to November are the best times, hot but not scorching, with the sea warm. Winter brings reliable sun around 22 to 24°C, though evenings are cool and the sea is fresh. June to September regularly passes 37°C.

things.name: Ras Mohammed
things.blurb: A marine national park with coral walls, sharks and shoals of fish.

things.name: Naama Bay
things.blurb: The lively centre, with a beach promenade, restaurants and shops.

things.name: House reefs
things.blurb: Many hotels sit on a reef, so you can snorkel right from the jetty.

things.name: Tiran Island
things.blurb: Boat trips to some of the Red Sea's most famous reefs.

things.name: Old Market
things.blurb: Spices, lamps and souvenirs around a modern mosque.

things.name: Desert safari
things.blurb: Quad bikes, camels and a Bedouin dinner under the stars.

faqs.question: Is Sharm el-Sheikh good in winter?
faqs.answer: Yes, it's one of the warmest places within 5 hours of the UK, at around 22 to 24°C. Bring a jumper for evenings and boat trips.

faqs.question: Do you need a visa for Sharm el-Sheikh?
faqs.answer: A free Sinai stamp covers stays in Sharm and the south Sinai coast for up to 15 days. For Cairo or Luxor, buy a full visa.

faqs.question: Is the snorkelling good in Sharm?
faqs.answer: It's some of the best in the world. Ras Mohammed and the Tiran reefs are highlights.

faqs.question: How long is the flight to Sharm el-Sheikh?
faqs.answer: About 5 to 5.5 hours from the UK.
